mapper.sql: r.id, r.user_id AS userId, r.mal_anime_id AS malAnimeId, r.title, r.content, r.report_count AS reportCount, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt, u.username AS username, u.nickname AS nickname, rt.score AS score
JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN ratings rt ON rt.user_id = r.user_id AND rt.mal_anime_id = r.mal_anime_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM reviews r WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT FROM reviews r WHERE r.mal_anime_id = #{malAnimeId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT FROM reviews r ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM reviews r ORDER BY r.report_count DESC, r.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews (user_id, mal_anime_id, title, content) VALUES (#{userId}, #{malAnimeId}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM reviews WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE reviews SET report_count = report_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE reviews SET report_count = 0 WHERE id = #{id}
